historical_execution_meaning: No execution certification at original recordT; does not falsely assert every producer exit missing. Native exact-zero tuples never use this observation. HG061/HG062 output values unchanged.

revision_claim_roles.REPORT_T: distinct original report revision claim, no source lookup/rebinding
revision_claim_roles.SOURCE_T: content-revision claim distinct from recordT, no source lookup/reuse certification
revision_claim_roles.PRODUCER_Z: independently bound full post-test producer revision
revision_claim_roles.PRODUCER_Z_PREFIX: exact abbreviated spelling of independently bound Z; never a lookup pointer

exit_attribution.normal_native_exit0: ordinary native path, zero documentary count, separate native oracle remains mandatory

components.unknown_revision_rule: Never substitute recordT, planned values or prior source revision
components.counts: typed positive integers 1..1000000, original claims; no actual execution count certification
components.reason: DOCKER_API_DENIED where the closed original report states it

inventory.mandatory_tuple_set: all durable tuples discovered by native inventory, not caller-selected subset
inventory.documentary_unverified_count: exact nonnegative integer, never Boolean; consumed documentary tuples only
inventory.lineage_gap_count: exact nonnegative non-Boolean integer per affected consumed documentary tuple; zero iff no independently enumerated affected tuple
inventory.mandatory_lineage_gap_tuple_set: independently enumerated native binding-gap tuples, not derived from observation output; must match consumed gap entries exactly
inventory.mandatory_native_tuple_set: independent exact native-reader tuple enumeration; never inferred from missing entries/native ordinals
inventory.inseparable_original_observations: Original immutable report bytes plus independently derived existing native facts are uniquely parsed and emitted inside inventory; original record order and exact typed attribution are authoritative. Candidate outputs never supply expected provenance.
inventory.emitted_observations: Exact internally derived ordered report outputs, alongside counts and limitations; no reconsumption as original facts or success cache
inventory.candidate_outputs: Optional untrusted exact corroboration only; bounded value/type/key/order comparison against newly derived original observations; all coordinated permutations and welltyped substitutions DENY

affected_branch.original_delivery: independently bound original protected delivery M
affected_branch.tested_tree: full immutable T tree object identity
affected_branch.delivery_tree: full immutable M tree object identity
affected_branch.tested_parents: ordered actual full parent commit identities at T
affected_branch.delivery_parents: ordered actual full parent commit identities at M

delivery_lineage.meaning: Explicit archival delivery-lineage gap only; never ancestry/equivalence/integration/execution/review/acceptance proof

entry_schema.dimensions: exact mandatory dimension values/types; unknown field/enum, Boolean-for-integer or fabricated certification DENY
entry_schema.purpose: exact closed check ordinal purpose from SLOT_ROLES, not just any allowed enum
entry_schema.limitations: exact ordered closed per-ordinal limits plus no-native-execution and lineage limit as applicable; no missing/extra/duplicate/unknown limit
entry_schema.revision_claims: exact role-defined keys; separately attributed full revisions differ from recordT, producer prefix exactly matches separately bound full Z
entry_schema.exit_attribution: null unless exact post-test/final-T exit role; then exact keys/kind/producer/int0/execution_certified=false
entry_schema.delivery_lineage: null or exact affected_branch keys, values and same entry B/T/C, full named object metadata; gap predicate remains false

report_schema.native_capture_profile: NATIVE_CAPTURE_PATH has no documentary/component claims; every tuple independently native
report_schema.partition: covered tuples exactly partition in original order into entries and native_ordinals; native tuples exactly equal independently enumerated mandatory native tuple set; documentary complement exactly equals mandatory minus native; all globally unique
report_schema.components: exact finite ordered component role fields/types/counts, revision rules and execution_certified=false
report_schema.counts: exact non-Boolean nonnegative integers per consumed documentary/gap tuple; native zero documentary
